page.title: [» Send videos · Taalcut «]
steps.label: [» Steps «]
foot.note: [» Your videos go straight to your Mac over this Wi-Fi, never through the internet. «]
pair.title: [» Connect to your Mac «]
pair.lede: [» Type the PIN shown next to the QR code on your Mac. «]
pair.ledeCode: [» Type the setup code and the PIN shown on your Mac. «]
pair.expired: [» This phone’s connection to your Mac ran out. Type the PIN your Mac shows now. «]
pair.ledeApprove: [» On your computer, choose Allow to let this phone send videos. «]
pair.expiredApprove: [» This phone’s connection to your computer ran out. Choose Allow on your computer to connect again. «]
approval.waiting: [» Waiting for approval on your computer… «]
approval.match: [» Your computer shows the same number «]
approval.busy: [» Another phone is asking your computer right now. Wait a moment, then ask again. «]
approval.refused: [» This QR code no longer works. Scan the new one on your computer, or type the setup code and PIN it shows. «]
code.label: [» Setup code «]
code.hint: [» Eight letters and numbers, shown on your Mac. «]
pin.label: [» PIN «]
pin.hint: [» Six digits, shown on your Mac. «]
pair.error.invalid: [» Type all six digits of the PIN. «]
pair.error.rejected: [» That PIN didn’t match. Check the digits on your Mac and try again. «]
pair.error.network: [» Can’t reach your Mac. Check both are on the same Wi-Fi, then try again. «]
pair.error.rate: [» Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again. «]
pair.error.closed: [» Your Mac isn’t listening yet. In Taalcut’s Library, click From your phone, then try again. «]
pair.error.full: [» Five phones are already connected to your Mac. «]
pair.help: [» Can’t see a PIN? On your Mac, open Taalcut, go to Library and click From your phone. If it shows a new QR code, scan that one. «]
choose.title: [» Choose videos «]
choose.lede: [» Pick as many as you like. Each one goes into your Mac’s library as it arrives. «]
choose.ledeIos: [» Files sends the original. Photos is quicker, but your iPhone may send a smaller copy. «]
pick.photosNote: [» Quicker, may be a smaller copy «]
pick.anyNote: [» Videos and photos, as many as you like «]
guide.title: [» Videos not in Files yet? «]
guide.step1: [» Open Photos and select the videos. «]
guide.step2: [» Tap Share, then Save to Files. «]
guide.step3: [» Pick On My iPhone, then come back here. «]
page.keepOpen: [» Keep this page open and your phone unlocked until every video says Added. «]
send.title: [» Sending to your Mac «]
state.smallerCopy: [» Your phone sent a smaller copy of this video. For the original, choose it from the Files app. «]
reason.paused: [» It carries on by itself when the connection is back. «]
reason.ghost: [» This page was reloaded. Choose this video again to finish sending it. «]
error.unauthorized: [» Your Mac needs you to connect again. «]
error.forbidden: [» Your Mac turned this video away. Try again in a moment. «]
error.tooLarge: [» This video is too big for your Mac. «]
error.notMedia: [» Your Mac only takes videos and photos. «]
error.diskFull: [» Your Mac is out of space. Free some up, then try again. «]
error.importFailed: [» Your Mac couldn’t add it to the library. Try again. «]
done.title: [» All on your Mac «]
done.lede: [» Everything is in your Mac’s library. You can close this page. «]
done.ledeSome: [» Your Mac couldn’t take the rest. Each one says why. «]
lost.title: [» Lost the connection «]
lost.body: [» Your phone can’t reach your Mac. Check both are on the same Wi-Fi. Videos carry on from where they stopped. «]
waiting.title: [» Waiting for your Mac «]
waiting.body: [» On your Mac, open Taalcut, go to Library and click From your phone. This page carries on by itself. «]
